blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Risa Hontiveros met with representatives of Roblox at the Senate on Wednesday to discuss online safety measures for children and pressed for the designation of a legal representative based in the Philippines. During the meeting, Hontiveros said the representative should serve as a direct channel for Philippine authorities in cases involving online abuse and other threats to children. “Kapag may batang Pilipinong posibleng biktima ng grooming o online sexual abuse, bawat oras ay mahalaga. Kailangang alam agad ng ating mga awtoridad kung sino ang lalapitan,” Hontiveros said in a press release on Thursday. (When a Filipino child […]...
